title: Sephadex/Sephacryl Purification of AFLP Products
author: Michal Ronikier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rq8d5zw
materials: Pipet 300 µl of the mixture to each well of the Millipore purification plate.NOTE: Use the Matrix electronic pipet >> Fill at 1250 µl, Disp at 300 µl).

Match and place the prepared purification plates (Millipore plates with fresh Sephadex/Sephacryl layer prepared as described above) on new Eppendorf plates. describe the contents of the Eppendorf plate beforehand. double-check carefully the orientation of the two plates! fix the two plates additionally with small pieces of tape on both sides.
Pipet 300 µl of the mixture to each well of the Millipore purification plate.NOTE: Use the Matrix electronic pipet >> Fill at 1250 µl, Disp at 300 µl).

steps.title: Liquefy Sephacryl and Sephadex
steps.instruction: Prepare the resin bottles using a shaker to ensure they are liquid.

substeps.instruction: Place the Sephacryl bottle on the shaker for 5-10 minutes at speed 4-5.
Add the Sephadex mixture bottle for the final minute and decrease shaker speed to 3-4.

steps.title: Prepare Sephadex/Sephacryl Mixture
steps.instruction: Create a 1:1 (v/v) solution of pre-prepared 5% Sephadex G50 and Sephacryl S200.

substeps.instruction: Mix 35 ml of 5% Sephadex G50 with 35 ml of Sephacryl S200.

steps.title: Prepare Millipore Plates
steps.instruction: Place the Millipore plates on trash plates and centrifuge for 1 minute at 2800 rpm.

steps.title: Purify Selective PCR Product
steps.instruction: Apply the PCR product to the membranes for purification.

substeps.instruction: Pipet the whole volume of the selective PCR product onto the center of the Sephadex/Sephacryl membranes using a multichannel pipette, ensuring the pipette does not touch the membranes.

steps.title: Collect Filtrated Product
steps.instruction: Remove the Millipore plate and collect the filtrated PCR product in an Eppendorf plate for subsequent dilution.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Mix for Analysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the final sample mix for each sample.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µl of Hi-Di formamide and 0.1 µl of Gene Scan-500 ROX size standard.
Add 1-1.5 µl of the purified and diluted PCR product to the mix.

steps.title: Clean and Reuse Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the Millipore plates for reuse.

substeps.instruction: Leave the Sephadex resin to dry at ambient temperature until it contracts for easy removal.
Load the plates with a new Sephadex/Sephacryl mixture (plates can be reused up to three times).
